L519111338 REFEREE'S DEED THIS DEED, made the  day of November,1999, between FREDERICK J. MARTORELL , having an address at 1432 86" Street Brooklyn, New York ,the Referee duly appointed in the action hereinafter mentioned ("Grantor"), and OBER INDUSTRIES INC.a domestic corporation having place business c/o Joel Levy 22S West 34 Street New York, New York ("Grantee"). WITNESSETH, that Grantor, the Referee appointed in an action by OBER INDUSTRIES INC. as Plaintiffagainst SIMPLEX CORPORATION et al.as Defendants, foreclosing a Mortgage recorded on November 22, 1989, in the office of the Clerk of the County of Kings in Reel 2478 page 422, pursuant to a judgment of foreclosure and sale entered by the Supreme Court of the State of NewYork,Kings County,on 2"day of September 1999 and in consideration of Two hundredand ten thousand ($210,000.00) Dollars Dollars paid by the Grantee, being the highest sum bid at the sale under said judgment, does hereby grant and convey unto Grantee and the heirs, executors, administrators, successors and assigns of Grantee forever, ALL that certain plot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in New York, the County of Kings,and the State of New York, being more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto and madeapart hereof, TOGETHER with the appurtenances and all the estate and rights of Grantor in and to said premises, TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the premises herein granted unto Grantee and the heirs, executors, administrators, successors and assigns of Grantee forever. INWITNESSWHEREOF Grantorhasdulyexecuted thisdeedonthedatefirst above written. FREDERICKJ.MARTORELL Referee
